My Event Match a global marketplace for events.

My Event Match is a two-sided marketplace for events. Customers post the job for their wedding, birthday, engagement or party, and matched partners quote to win the work. We built the whole platform in custom PHP and JavaScript on the Nifty Websites AI builder, live in Australia and worldwide, with the USA, UK and New Zealand launching soon.

The project

The work in short.

The platform

A worldwide marketplace that connects people planning events with trusted event professionals, from weddings and engagements to birthdays and parties.

How it works

Customers post a job and get matched with the right partners. Partners subscribe, buy lead credits and quote on the jobs that suit them, so both sides get the best match.

The build

A serious custom build, PHP and JavaScript scripting on the Nifty Websites AI builder, with the functionality of a full B2B and B2C platform.

How it works

A marketplace for both sides.

Two connected experiences on one platform, one for the customers booking events, one for the partners who win the work.

For customers (B2C)

Post the job for your event, get matched with the right professionals, then compare quotes and book with confidence.

What we delivered

Everything in the build.

  • A two-sided marketplace, B2B and B2COne platform serving both the customers booking events and the partners competing to win the work.
  • Book a job and get matchedCustomers post their event, from weddings to birthdays, and are matched with the right professionals for the job.
  • Subscriptions, credits and quoting for partnersPartners choose subscription packages, buy lead credits, and quote on the jobs that suit them best.
  • Mockup generators and smart matchingTools that help partners put their best foot forward, and matching that pairs each job with the right partners.
